module_summary: Reservoir flow controller: six-state Moore FSM tracking water level and its last direction from 3 sensors, decoding a 4-bit valve-control vector.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Level-and-trend controller register; next state chosen from sensor inputs s.

anchors.name: fr
anchors.why: State-decoded valve vector driving fr2, fr1, fr0 and dfr outputs.

groups.name: Level controller
